r.Volodmartz/Opascari: Zoria's Cave in the Opascari mountains was found filled with a hungry darkness that ate light and swallowed several of the expedition.
r.Zenith/Lustri: Mentioned in passing: scholars of the Unfettered Mind ventured into the depths of Lustri to consult an ancient tree spirit during their research.

When Spring comes.d: The Drakes, billeted in Mitwold, beat Cold Sun and then storm-borne shark heralds of Siakha, losing about 30 soldiers; the Wayford Wanderers were wiped out. Siakha then offered illegal boons to the Drakes and to Marcher ritualists, and Marcher fleets raiding the Jotun returned with double their plunder. In Bregasland, House Greywater felt snubbed. Three households stood accused of collaborating with the Fishers, and the magistrates asked the Senate to draw a line, send in the magistrates, or let violence run its course. Bushel Sykes was killed by Imperial citizens. Jack confirmed that Mournwold Orcs could bond as Marchers, a mandate to do so was proposed, and a conjunction to Hap the Soft's farm opened.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Siakha's messenger to the Drakes arrived dressed in Grendel colours but claimed to serve the Maelstrom, and was received only because the Empire remained at peace with the Grendel.
n.Imperial Orcs: Bloodcrow Knott's statement of principle reached Hap the Soft, who invited Knott and other Imperial Orc priests, perhaps including Bloodcrow Udoo, to visit Golden Hoof Farm through a Sentinel Gate conjunction.
n.Jotun: Marcher fleets raiding the Jotun's Gullet Shore were guided by Siakha's creatures to vulnerable Jotun ships, settlements and caravans. In Bregasland, the legacy of the Jotun-backed Fisher occupation fuelled bitter accusations of collaboration.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: Navarr soldiers helped with the Upwold harvest, and a Navarr messenger carried Hap the Soft's invitation to Bloodcrow Knott.
n.The Marches: The Marches endured shark attacks in Mitwold and dangerous tensions over collaboration in Bregasland, and were offered illegal boons by the enmity-bound eternal Siakha. The nation also learned that the Mournwold Orcs could join it through the egregore Jack.

t.Bregasland: Feuds over collaboration with Mathilda Fisher, the snubbing of House Greywater and the killing of Bushel Sykes left the territory close to violence. The Senate was asked to choose between drawing a line, sending in the magistrates, or letting the Bregas settle scores themselves.
t.Mitwold: Storm-borne shark heralds of Siakha attacked across Mitwold, burning farms and salting fields, but the Drakes held them off at the cost of about 30 soldiers and the Wayford Wanderers foot-the-ball team.
t.Mournwold: Young Mournwold orcs went out to work across the Marches. Jack confirmed they could bond to the nation, and a Synod mandate to welcome them as Marchers was proposed.
t.Skarsind: Mentioned in passing: a minority of Marchers asked why the Mournwold orcs could not all simply move to Skarsind.
t.Tromsa: Mentioned in passing: some Mitwolders grumbled that the Drakes should have been in Tromsa with the other armies hunting Mathilda Fisher.
t.Upwold: Upwold stayed largely quiet. Marchers, Mournwold orcs, Freeborn and Navarr soldiers worked the harvest together while fortifications and billeted armies fended off Cold Sun.

r.Bregasland/Grey Fens: The Droverbill clan of the south-eastern Grey Fens were accused of taking Fisher money to keep the Feni quiet and of refusing to help the Greywaters, and Joan Droverbill sat on the Council of Bregas.
r.Bregasland/North Fens: House Brawness, a large North Fens household, was accused of sheltering the Jotun, taking Fisher payment and guiding smaller households to cooperate, and Steward Aldith Brawness sat on the Council of Bregas.
r.Bregasland/The Rushes: The Clakes of Beandown were accused of informing for the Fishers in return for land and goats. A clash over stolen goats left three dead, and Rory Clake and two members of House Hiswen were arrested.
r.Mitwold/Golden Downs: Mentioned in passing: the Golden Downs are named among the places where the Drakes met and gutted Siakha's shark creatures.
r.Mitwold/Oddmire: The Oddmire Allfriars escaped the worst of the shark attack on their match with the Wayford Wanderers, and Oddmire was among the places where the Drakes fought off the creatures.
r.Mournwold/Green March: At Golden Hoof Farm, Hap the Soft shunned the League questioner Graime and invited Imperial Orc priests to visit. A conjunction allows up to seven people to visit the farm at the coming summit.
